label: Whole-effect: a total cause of a thing's being has every perfection of the thing
paraphrase: Analyst formulation of the Cartesian containment clause on its whole-effect scope (CONTAINMENT_SCOPE_2; navigation: Descartes, Meditation III, the stone that cannot begin to exist unless produced by something containing everything in the stone; attribution deferred): whatever is the efficient and total cause of x's being (CausesIn c x esse and Total c x esse) is in act in every perfection r in which x is in act. Uniform IN_ACT_4 reading on both sides; the mode-asymmetric reading is an unformalized sibling. Sibling of the respect-wise reading 90c0d77f. Open.
